Implemented all four fixes:
- `interleave_evenly` gracefully handles no inputs.
- `sliced` immediately rejects negative sizes with `ValueError`.
- Reversing an empty `numeric_range` yields no items.
- Reverse iteration preserves the original numeric values exactly.

Validation: all 924 existing tests passed, along with targeted edge-case checks.

Added requirement confidence estimates in `STATUS.json`.
